QuestInfo.name: The True Culprit?
QuestInfo.0: Winston stopped talking in the middle of your conversation. Just what is he up to? Talk to him again.
QuestInfo.1: According to Winston, if the Stumps didn't take the diary, then it must've been the Dark Stumps. Investigate #b#e50 Dark Stumps#k#n in #bDusty Wind Hill#k and find Chromile's diary.
QuestInfo.2: You found the diary from the Dark Stumps, but the contents are gone. It's unlikely you'll get reliable information from Winston anymore.
QuestInfo.parent: Where in Maple World is Chromile the Knight?
